canonical_ledger.binding: Local public canonical ledger exactly matches census runtime-manifest bytes

label_basis: Reuses saved public Racket labels from the source-bound lesson census; this tool does not invoke Racket authority or generate new labels.
limits: Finite declared-rival evidence, not proof of identifiability or training admission.
Every holdout reuses the retained labelled bundle; no new draw or authority call occurs.
Rivals are assumed deterministic; cached predictions are checked for valid grids and input purity.
Canonical labels are recovered from the exact ledger bound by the retained runtime manifest.
